You're working on ConvertScan (CROBOT) at /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT.

Stack: React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui + Supabase + React Query + Recharts + Framer Motion. Never use `any` type.

## Task: Sprint 3A — Competitor URL Comparison (Growth+ plans)

The database migration `supabase/migrations/010_competitor_comparison.sql` already exists with `competitor_groups` and `competitor_urls` tables.

### Read these files first:
- `src/types/index.ts` — current types, plan helpers (isGrowthPlus)
- `src/types/database.ts` — DB type patterns
- `src/hooks/use-scans.ts` — existing scan creation pattern (useCreateScan)
- `src/pages/Reports.tsx` — page layout pattern to follow
- `src/App.tsx` — current routes
- `src/components/AppSidebar.tsx` — current nav items
- `src/lib/constants.ts` — CRO_PILLARS array
- `src/components/shared/ScoreRing.tsx` — existing score ring component

### 1. Types

**`src/types/index.ts`** — Add after ScanHistoryEntry:
```typescript
export interface CompetitorGroup {
  id: string;
  user_id: string;
  name: string;
  primary_url: string;
  created_at: string;
}

export interface CompetitorUrl {
  id: string;
  group_id: string;
  url: string;
  scan_id: string | null;
  latest_score: number | null;
  scanned_at: string | null;
}
```

**`src/types/database.ts`** — Add `CompetitorGroupRow`, `CompetitorUrlRow` types and add both tables to the Database interface.

### 2. Hook

**Create `src/hooks/use-competitors.ts`:**
- `useCompetitorGroups()` — fetches all groups for current user with their URLs (join competitor_urls)
- `useCreateCompetitorGroup()` — mutation: creates group + inserts competitor URLs
- `useDeleteCompetitorGroup(groupId)` — mutation: deletes group (cascade deletes URLs)
- `useScanCompetitor()` — mutation: invokes the existing analyze-url edge function for a competitor URL, then updates competitor_urls row with scan_id and latest_score

For the scan functionality, call `supabase.functions.invoke("analyze-url", { body: { url, page_type: "landing" } })` — same as how a regular scan works. After the scan completes, update the competitor_urls row.

### 3. Components

**Create `src/components/competitors/CompetitorCreateForm.tsx`:**
- Form with:
  - Group name input (default: "My Competitors")
  - Primary URL input (your website URL)
  - 1-4 competitor URL inputs (start with 1, "Add another" button adds up to 4)
  - "Create & Scan All" button
- Uses Dialog from shadcn/ui
- Validates URLs (same pattern as onboarding modal)
- On submit: creates group, inserts URLs, triggers scan for each URL

**Create `src/components/competitors/CompetitorRadarChart.tsx`:**
- Props: `data: Array<{ name: string; scores: Record<CroPillar, number> }>`
- Recharts RadarChart with:
  - 7 axes (one per CRO pillar)
  - One colored line per URL (primary = primary color, competitors = different colors)
  - Legend at bottom
  - Tooltip showing exact scores
  - 300px height
- Use CRO_PILLARS from constants for axis labels

**Create `src/components/competitors/CompetitorScoreTable.tsx`:**
- Props: `primaryUrl: string; competitors: Array<{ url: string; scores: Record<CroPillar, number> | null; overallScore: number | null }>`
- Table with:
  - Rows: 7 CRO pillars + Overall Score row
  - Columns: Pillar name, Primary URL score, Competitor 1 score, Competitor 2 score, etc.
  - Each cell: score number + color (green if highest in row, red if lowest, neutral otherwise)
  - Winner badge on the highest score per row
- Use shadcn/ui Table component

### 4. Page

**Create `src/pages/Competitors.tsx`:**
- Page header: "Competitor Benchmarking" with subtitle
- If no groups exist: EmptyState with "Add your first competitor group" CTA
- If groups exist: List of groups, each showing:
  - Group name (editable)
  - Primary URL with ScoreRing (mini, 40px)
  - Competitor URLs with their scores
  - "Scan All" button to re-scan all URLs
  - "Delete Group" button
  - Expandable: CompetitorRadarChart + CompetitorScoreTable
- "New Comparison" button opens CompetitorCreateForm dialog
- Loading skeleton while fetching
- Plan gate: if user is not growth+, show PremiumLock

### 5. Routes & Nav

**Modify `src/App.tsx`:**
- Import Competitors page (lazy load)
- Add route: `<Route path="/competitors" element={<ProtectedRoute><Competitors /></ProtectedRoute>} />`

**Modify `src/components/AppSidebar.tsx`:**
- Add nav item after "Score History": `{ title: "Competitors", url: "/competitors", icon: Swords }`
- Import Swords from lucide-react

### Requirements:
- No `any` types
- Radar chart must use Recharts RadarChart (already installed)
- Plan gate: only growth+ users can access (show PremiumLock for lower plans)
- Follow existing page layout patterns (PageTransition wrapper, PageHeader, etc.)
- Use framer-motion for card entrance animations
- Mobile-responsive: stack cards vertically on mobile
